name: Agency Partner
summary: Senior delivery capacity for agencies that need dependable product engineering behind their client relationships.
scope: White-label or named delivery under agreed operating terms
Web, mobile, backend, and Web3 product engineering
Defined projects or embedded monthly support
Technical planning, implementation, verification, and handover
Direct client communication only when the partner approves it
exclusions: Work started without an agreed scope, access, and decision owner
Direct solicitation of the agency's client relationships
Formal security, penetration, or compliance certification
Silent expansion beyond the approved project or monthly capacity
deliverables: An agreed delivery plan and working rhythm
Production implementation within the approved scope
Progress visibility, risk escalation, and decision records
Verification evidence and a clean technical handover

faq.question: Can XPL work under our agency brand?
faq.answer: Yes. White-label delivery is available under written confidentiality, ownership, communication, and non-solicitation terms.

faq.question: Will XPL speak directly with our client?
faq.answer: Only when you approve it. The agency remains the relationship owner and sets the communication model.

faq.question: How does pricing work?
faq.answer: Defined projects start from ₦1,500,000 or $3,000. Embedded support starts from ₦1,200,000 per month or $2,500 per month, subject to scope and capacity.

faq.question: Who owns the delivered work?
faq.answer: The written engagement terms define ownership, licensing, third-party components, and handover. Client-specific work is transferred as agreed after payment.
